notes: The 'at' before 'the Dedication' is the construct relation of שִׁיר חֲנֻכַּת recast with a preposition (rule 19) rather than rule 33's adverbial accusative; placement on חֲנֻכַּת is the same either way.

The italic second 'A Psalm' is left added; the competing reading treats it as a second realization of the one מִזְמוֹר in a discontinuous unit under rule 25, but the ASV italic corroborates a supply and the accepted reading is retained.
